acceptance: The core plans-companion reference describes both fields, when they appear, and that the stored plan is the last captured one.
context: From benchbox-site PR #124. User-facing docs live in benchbox-site (moved by #3545); check whether core still keeps a reference that needs this, otherwise close as covered by the site page docs/features/query-plan-analysis.md.
description: PR #3887 added optional fingerprint_varied and fingerprint_variants ({fingerprint, iteration, run_type}) to plans companion entries when DataFrame executions of one query captured different plans. The site now documents and renders them, but the core reference docs that describe the plans companion do not mention them.
